manifest.method: Compute ainglish minus English tokens per complete pair for each tokenizer. Average all 6 pairs equally per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are tokenizer min/max. Retain every finite outcome.

estimand.population: the 6 complete fresh sanction pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful-English requirement, reason, non-resolution, and out-of-scope mapping
estimand.interpretation: token cost of carrying the complete sanction contract, not marker length versus an unqualified request

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before tokenizer import or token observation.
